text: マサキくん　からか　れいを　いっておいて　くれ！

structure.jp: マサキくん　からか
れいを　いっておいて　くれ！
structure.en: pass on my thanks for me!

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: ておく after a verb means doing something ahead of time so that it is taken care of. いっておいて = 'say it for me so it's done'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.span: いっておいて　くれ
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くれ is a blunt man's way of asking someone to do something for him. いっておいてくれ = 'tell him for me'.

patterns.name: 〜か (realizing)
patterns.explanation: か said to yourself after hearing something new shows it has just sunk in, like 'oh, so that's it'. マサキくんからか = 'so it's from Bill, huh'.
